thread:
Ava: midweek combo idea — 5x400m intervals on the treadmill then a couple of easy topouts at the office wall after. Thu 6:30pm at HQ gym? thinking about short + social, not a full workout. Strava route: https://strava.app.link/abc123
Sam: I'm up for it. can only make it by 7pm though, heads up. :sweat_smile:
Jun: remote this week so won't be there in person, but I can do a solo 4x400 on the hill and post the splits. post-run coffee? :coffee:
Erin: prefer to just boulder that night — fingers need some love. count me for the wall portion only. :muscle:
Ava: cool. quick poll — react on this thread: :runner: = run + climb, :bust_in_silhouette: = climb only, :turtle: = sit this one out but cheer. if we get >3 :runner: I'll aim to start at 6:30, otherwise we push to 7. :ballot_box_with_ballot:
Maya: :runner:
Sam: :runner: (I can swing the run if someone else leads the intervals at 6:30, otherwise I'll join at 7 for climbing)
Jun: posted my morning solo — small section from the hill: 
```
5.0 mi, 38:12, avg 7:38/mi
Splits: 7:45, 7:30, 7:40, 7:20, 7:37
```
Erin: :bust_in_silhouette: — will bring a tape mat and extra chalk. anyone need tape or pads?
Ava: I can bring tape. also bringing the travel crash pad from my car just in case. :white_check_mark:
FitBot: Poll tally so far — :runner: 2, :bust_in_silhouette: 2, :turtle: 0. Suggestion: start 6:45 to accommodate both groups.
Ava: thanks FitBot — 6:45 it is. Booking the gym slot and marking in the calendar. See you all Thu at 6:45pm (Main Gym, lower-level wall). Bring shoes, tape, and a smile. :smile:
Maya: see you! might bring a guest — ping me if that's a problem.
Sam: guest ok by me. looking forward to gentle suffering. :joy:
